settings.question: How do I measure for a made-to-measure worktop?
settings.answer: Measure the length along the wall and the depth from the wall to the front edge in millimetres. Add any overhang you want. If you're unsure, request a free quote and we'll template on site.

settings.question: What is the maximum size you can cut?
settings.answer: Up to 3200 x 1600 mm from a single slab. Larger runs are joined with a near-invisible seam.

settings.question: Which thickness should I choose?
settings.answer: 20 mm suits sleek, modern kitchens. 30 mm gives a solid, traditional look and is ideal for long unsupported spans.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Most made-to-measure worktops are cut and delivered within 7-10 working days.

settings.question: Do you offer installation?
settings.answer: Yes. Our professional fitting teams cover the whole of the UK. Ask for installation in your quote request.

settings.question: Can I order a sample first?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Use "Order a Free Sample" on any worktop page and we'll post one to you.

settings.heading: Still have a question?
settings.text: Our UK-based team is happy to help.
